_comment: Ratchet baseline for the TRUE HEALTH word 0x800A6594. This exists because the B06/B08 damage-immunity claim depends entirely on 0x8004A888 being the only instruction that DECREMENTS health on a contact path -- if another damage-side writer existed, intercepting one site would not be immunity. An earlier immediate-only scan reported 'exactly 4 writers' and was wrong: it missed two zero-offset pointer stores. Regenerate: tools/census_address.py 0x800A6594 --block 0x800A6500 --expect analysis/phase4_b06_b08_census_expected_6594.json

writer_roles.0x8004A888: DAMAGE decrement -- the unique contact-path decrement, and the write the power slot intercepts
writer_roles.0x8005291C: results screen: clamp to 4 when health >= 5, not a damage path
writer_roles.0x80058890: heal pickup: health += 1 with sfx 62, an INCREMENT
